title: TriageBench Annotation Schema
description: Schema for TRIAGE P/K/R failure-type annotation records.

id.description: Unique sample ID, prefixed by source dataset (e.g., vqarad_0042)

dataset.description: Source dataset for the image-question pair

ground_truth.description: Correct answer from dataset ground truth

failure_type.description: Tri-model consensus failure etiology label. P=Perception, K=Knowledge, R=Reasoning

confidence.description: Annotation confidence. 'high' = all 3 models agree, 'medium' = 2/3 agree, 'low' = GPT-4o tiebreaker used

annotator_votes.description: Vote counts from the 3-model consensus pipeline (Llama-3.2-90B, Gemini-2.5-Pro, GPT-4o)

clinical_rationale.description: Free-text explanation of which decision gate failed (see annotation prompt in Supplementary A)

boundary_ambiguous.description: True if the sample lies in the 12% K/R boundary-ambiguity region

split.description: Dataset split assignment. Split indices are fixed in split_indices.json
